options.label: CPU model
options.help: CPU model. 68020+ are 32-bit; 68040/68060 include FPU and MMU. Higher models are faster.

options.label: 24-bit addressing
options.help: Essential for A500/A1200 compatibility. Disable for Z3 RAM usage.
options.constraint: 24-bit addressing is not available on a 68040 or 68060, with the JIT, or with a 32-bit accelerator board.

options.label: More compatible
options.help: Approximates prefetch pipeline of 68000/010. Required for some timing sensitive games.
options.constraint: More compatible is always on in cycle-exact modes and always off for a 68040 or 68060 with the JIT.

options.label: FPU
options.help: Floating point unit. A 68040 or 68060 uses its internal FPU.
options.constraint: A 68000 or 68010 in More compatible or cycle-exact mode has no FPU, and a 68040 or 68060 uses its internal FPU.

options.label: CPU speed
options.help: Fastest possible runs the CPU as fast as the host allows; the other mode matches original Amiga speed.

options.label: JIT cache size
options.help: Just-In-Time compilation cache in KB; 0 turns the JIT off. Greatly speeds up CPU emulation but reduces compatibility.
options.constraint: The JIT needs a 68020 or later, is not available in cycle-exact modes, and needs at least 128 KB.

options.label: JIT FPU support
options.help: Enable JIT compilation for FPU instructions.

options.label: Chipset
options.help: Original Chip Set (A500/A1000/A2000), Enhanced Chip Set (A600/A3000) or AGA (A1200/A4000).

options.label: NTSC
options.help: NTSC video mode (60 Hz) instead of PAL (50 Hz). Also moves the output refresh rate.

options.label: Cycle exactness
options.help: Bit-perfect CPU and DMA timing. Full needs a fast host; DMA/Memory only covers chipset accesses.

options.label: Immediate Blitter
options.help: Blitter operations complete instantly. Faster but less accurate.

options.label: Collision Level
options.help: Sprite and playfield collision detection. Full is the most compatible.

options.label: Chip RAM
options.help: Main memory accessible by all custom chips. A500 had 512 KB, A1200 2 MB; more than 512 KB requires ECS Agnus.
options.constraint: More than 2 MB excludes Zorro II fast RAM and Zorro II RTG boards; 1.5 MB is not available with the JIT.

options.label: Slow RAM
options.help: 512 KB expansion in the A500/A2000 trapdoor slot (Ranger RAM): accessible by custom chips but slower.
options.constraint: 1.8 MB conflicts with Gayle, Gary or Ramsey; 1.5 MB is not available with the JIT.

options.label: Z2 Fast RAM
options.help: Zorro II expansion memory. 16-bit, not accessible by custom chips, max 8 MB.
options.constraint: More than 256 KB excludes chip RAM above 2 MB.

options.label: Z3 Fast RAM
options.help: Zorro III expansion memory. 32-bit, used with 68030+ CPUs; not accessible by custom chips.
options.constraint: Needs 32-bit addressing, and is limited by the reserved Zorro III window.

options.label: Main ROM file
options.help: Kickstart ROM image. The default configuration picks the first suitable installed ROM.

options.label: Extended ROM file
options.help: Extended ROM image (CD32/CDTV extension or Arcadia bios).

options.label: Resolution autoswitch
options.help: Follow the Amiga's current screen mode; the percentages are the share of the frame that must switch before the render resolution changes.

options.label: Correct aspect ratio
options.help: Apply Amiga display aspect correction to native modes.
options.constraint: Not available with the Stretch scaling method.

options.label: Scaling method
options.help: How the display is scaled to fit the window.

options.label: Sound emulation
options.help: None turns all sound off; Emulated keeps Paula timing without output; Exact is most accurate.
options.constraint: Cycle-exact modes need at least emulated sound, so Disabled is not available in them.

options.label: Channel mode
options.help: Stereo, multi-channel and cloned-stereo output modes.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Frequency
options.help: Output sample rate; 44100 or 48000 is recommended for modern systems.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Buffer size
options.help: Audio buffer size; smaller values reduce latency but may glitch on slow systems.
options.constraint: Needs sound emulation to be on.

options.label: Port 1 device
options.help: Input device for joyport 1, the mouse port.

options.label: Port 2 device
options.help: Input device for joyport 2, the joystick port.

options.label: Port 1 mouse map
options.help: Drive the mouse with the analog stick of the Port 1 device.
options.constraint: Only in a non-default port mode.

options.label: Port 2 mouse map
options.help: Drive the mouse with the analog stick of the Port 2 device.
options.constraint: Only in a non-default port mode.

options.label: Analog joy-mouse speed
options.help: Mouse pointer speed when an analog stick drives the mouse; lower is slower.

options.label: On-screen Joystick
options.help: Show the virtual D-pad and fire buttons for touchscreen control.

options.label: On-screen Keyboard enabled
options.help: Show the Amiga-style on-screen keyboard overlay during emulation.

options.label: Include numeric keypad
options.help: Include the Amiga numeric keypad; keys will be smaller to fit the full keyboard.
options.constraint: Needs the on-screen keyboard enabled.

options.label: Keyboard button on On-screen Joystick
options.help: Show the KB touch button next to the fire buttons.
options.constraint: Needs the on-screen keyboard enabled.

options.label: Toggle button
options.help: Key or gamepad button that shows and hides the on-screen keyboard; empty unbinds it.
options.constraint: Needs the on-screen keyboard enabled and the RetroArch Vkbd button off.

options.label: DF0: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF0:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF0: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF0:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: DF1: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF1:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF1: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF1:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: DF2: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF2:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF2: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF2:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: DF3: image
options.help: Disk image in drive DF3:, or empty for no disk.
options.constraint: Needs the drive enabled.

options.label: DF3: drive type
options.help: Drive type of DF3:, or Disabled. AmigaOS sees a change after a reset.
options.constraint: FloppyBridge needs a build with FloppyBridge support.

options.label: CD drive
options.help: The CD drive's image or host drive, then optional fields (,image ,ioctl ,delay:). Empty for no CD drive, "empty" for a drive without a disc.
options.constraint: A change of disc or host drive applies at once; the startup delay (delay:) when the emulation starts.
